newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CEMIG MAINTAINED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CEMIG MAINTAINED AS BUY.

text.p: ING Barings on Wednesday said in a report it had reiterated its buy rating on Minas Gerais state power firm Cemig following the release of the firm's second quarter earnings.
- also said it maintained its June 1998 target price was of 76 reais per 1,000 preferred stock.

- Analyst Charles Barnett said Cemig's net income came to 62 million reais of 0.48 real per 1,000 shares, down 16 percent year-on-year compared with 0.57 real in the same period 1996 and 10 percent above ING's estimates of 0.43 real.
- "We believe the company is well positioned for further reductions in operating costs and productivity gains," he said in the report.
- Cemig preferred was up 0.88 percent at 55.99 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
